# Week 11 Wednesday Practice Report -- league-2

**Source and freshness.** Primary source is the committed `weekly-report-week-11.json` fixture, built by CI on Tuesday 2026-11-17 at 18:47 UTC (FantasyPros consensus + ESPN injuries + LLM news) -- current, so no degraded self-generated run was needed. Overlaid with a live pull of `nflreadpy.load_injuries(2026)` for Week 11, taken 2026-11-18 at 20:11 UTC.

**Practice report -- the headline, and it's a clean one.** Only HOU and IND have filed Week 11 injury/practice reports so far (the two teams playing Thursday night). Jonathan Taylor (RB, IND) is the one rostered player on either roster, and he does not appear on the report at all -- no designation, no practice-participation flag, which is the clean read, matching the fixture's own 'Healthy' tag and 0.961 P(play). No other rostered player's team (LAR, SEA, ATL, TB, CIN, DET, NYG x2, NYJ, NO, DEN, CAR) has filed a Week 11 practice report yet. That means every other row below carries the fixture's own designation, not a live practice-participation bucket -- all of them read 'Healthy' with no DNP/Limited/Full split to report. Recheck Thursday and Friday as the rest of the league files; that is when this run's practice-split framing (DNP 0.511 / Limited 0.702 / Full 0.790 for Questionables) will actually have something to chew on.

**Start these ten -- 130.10 expected points.**

| Slot | Player | Opp | Expected | P(play) | If he plays |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| QB | Bo Nix | vs LV (Sun) | 17.82 | 97.4% | 18.29 |
| RB | Bucky Irving | at DET (Sun) | 15.93 | 95.9% | 16.61 |
| RB | Cam Skattebo | vs JAX (Sun) | 15.56 | 92.2% | 16.88 |
| WR | Tee Higgins | at WAS (Mon) | 17.30 | 97.2% | 17.79 |
| WR | Jameson Williams | vs TB (Sun) | 11.60 | 97.2% | 11.93 |
| TE | Isaiah Likely | vs JAX (Sun) | 14.02 | 95.5% | 14.69 |
| FLEX | Jonathan Taylor | at HOU (Thu) | 13.65 | 96.1% | 14.21 |
| FLEX | Sam LaPorta | vs TB (Sun) | 11.06 | 95.5% | 11.59 |
| K | Jake Bates | vs TB (Sun) | 8.20 | 98.7% | 8.31 |
| DEF | Jets D/ST | at LAC (Sun) | 4.96 | 100% | 4.96 |

Bench: Tyler Shough (QB, 16.25 expected), Jalen Coker (WR, 9.54 expected). On bye: Matthew Stafford (QB), Jaxon Smith-Njigba (WR), Drake London (WR) -- the triple bye carries over from Monday.

**Changes since Monday.** One real swap: Bo Nix starts over Tyler Shough at QB. Monday's sandbox-only numbers had this as a 0.30-point near-tie (Shough 16.51 vs Nix 16.21); the real CI fixture widens it to a clear 1.57-point Nix lead (17.82 vs 16.25). Everything else that *looks* like a change isn't one -- Cam Skattebo now outprojects Jonathan Taylor (15.56 vs 13.65) and takes the RB2 label with Taylor sliding to FLEX, but both were starting Monday too, just with the labels swapped. No points move from that. Total expected points: 130.10, up from Monday's 123.47 -- all of the +6.63 is the data-source switch (committed fixture with real FantasyPros/ESPN data vs Monday's sandbox-degraded, nflreadpy-only run), not new injury or usage news.

**Still uncertain.** Genuinely nothing this week. Every rostered player with a game carries a clean 'Healthy' designation and no outstanding injury flag. The only soft spot is data completeness, not player health: 11 of this roster's 13 relevant teams (everyone but HOU/IND) have not yet filed a Week 11 report, so 'Healthy' here means 'nothing reported,' not 'confirmed clean.' Cam Skattebo is worth a second look once NYG files -- he carried an Out (hamstring) tag as recently as last week before clearing, and NYG hasn't re-filed yet this week.

**Opponent notes.** Jets D/ST faces LAC, a middling matchup, and this league's D/ST scoring has no return-yardage or yards-allowed line, which caps the ceiling on any D/ST projection by design -- 4.96 is close to typical for this matchup, not a sandbagged floor. Tee Higgins and Bucky Irving both carry minor season-long workload-management notes from the news layer (Cincinnati managing Higgins' snaps in blowouts, Tampa Bay trimming Irving's carry total post-bye) -- both are flagged low-risk, neither changes this week's start call.

**Byes ahead.** Week 11 (this week): Matthew Stafford (QB, LAR), Jaxon Smith-Njigba (WR, SEA), Drake London (WR, ATL) -- the triple bye. Week 13: Jonathan Taylor (RB, IND) and the Jets D/ST, flagged two weeks out as in Monday's briefing; no waiver move recommended yet, but worth planning a replacement for both.

**Sanity checks.** Ten full-PPR starters total 130.10 expected points -- inside the normal 100-140 band. Every if-he-plays number above is read straight from the committed fixture's own `conditionalPoints`, so there is no fixture/live divergence to flag this run.
